description: Shrink a PDF from freedailypro harder (the site's Aggressive mode): everything Balanced does, then pages become pictures in finer and finer steps (empty areas dropped, flat areas as plain fills, photos, text and small print at lower resolutions); a page is converted only when that is clearly smaller. Text on converted pages is no longer selectable and links and form fields on them are gone (textSelectable says which). Heavier than Balanced: it can take several seconds per page, and returns the best level finished so far (truncated: true) if the time budget runs out. Errors if the PDF is unreadable, password-protected, over 100 pages, or if nothing gets smaller.

fileBase64.description: The PDF, base64 encoded (up to 20 MB, up to 100 pages)

name: pdf_compress_aggressive
